answer: In this PoA design, each identity is verified by a Wesolowski VDF whose proof depends on a prescribed chain of continuous, sequential modular squarings. Because every squaring depends on the preceding result, an attacker simulating multiple clones cannot parallelize the dependency chains across GPUs; creating identities therefore multiplies elapsed wall-clock work. A mirror attack gains no shortcut, while dawn and zephyr nodes face the same physical delay.
